composition.check: propylene mole fraction read from the table and confirmed by a mole balance on the mixer feeds: 79.67 kmol/h x 0.990453 / 13,810 kmol/h = 0.00571; benzene is the assumed balance (no other component identified). Gives 77.9 kg/kmol against the report's 1,071,616/13,810 = 77.6, so about 0.4% of the stream is unexplained

tolerance.note: the spread across property packages in this case is about 6%, as large as the gap to the report, so a single-package match is partly luck

scenarios.why: the mole balance gives 0.00571 where the table gives 0.00574: both are inside the reading uncertainty of the reconstruction
the 0.4% mismatch between mole flow x reconstructed molar mass and the reported mass flow: take the mass flow implied by 13,810.09 kmol/h instead of the reported one
